items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1974-01-01
items.q: INTERVIEWER mentions 'Tony's interest' and 'Tony goes out', but the INTERVIEWEE does not mention Tony or respond to the mention of Tony specifically, only to the general comment about relationships.

ctx.x: Well, we're not going to find any more scrapbooks here, I'm sure of that. But we've stripped them.

Yeah. Well, we'll straighten them out tomorrow and find some... Yeah, you would be fixing to leave and all of this. Yeah, but I mean, in time, I have more success, right? But you know about Tony's interest. He came and Tony goes out. Tony goes out, sure.

Well, that's good. I hope you made a happy relationship. Another thing I would most certainly like to include, as a daughter biotica, is the, yeah, I attended church all my life. In fact, I can't remember a missing church on Sunday. And a lot of people would meet me in my travels, and the first thing they would say, I would say, Don, do you still go to church on Sundays? Well, the pastor told me, yes, I just come from church. And, of course, I don't profess to be an angel, because I've been a devil in other…
